item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description:
The first public version. Take a screenshot and paste it: ClipShot puts every screenshot on the clipboard the moment macOS saves it, and the file stays where macOS saves it. Screen recordings come in 1.0.

  • Its own floating preview, so the copy does not wait for the macOS thumbnail. Click it to mark the screenshot up in Markup and the edited image is copied, drag it into any app, or swipe it away. Prefer the macOS thumbnail? Pick it in Settings; copying then waits until the thumbnail goes away.
  • The menu bar popover lists your four most recent screenshots, with Copy, Show in Finder and Move to Trash. A screenshot moved to the Trash can be put back with Undo for a few seconds, in the popover or right on the floating preview.
  • Optional cleanup, off until you turn it on: screenshots older than a period you choose go to the Trash. Only screenshots ClipShot saw being taken, in the folder you confirmed. Older ones only when you add them yourself, and a renamed screenshot is kept.
  • Peg, the clothes peg in the menu bar, shows what just happened: it pegs up every copy, lets the picture drop when you move a screenshot to the Trash, grips it again on Undo and gives a little squeeze when you open the menu. With Reduce Motion it changes without moving.
  • Shortcuts actions to get the latest or recent screenshots, copy the latest one, pause and resume copying and clean up old screenshots now, with phrases for Siri and Spotlight.
  • A Focus filter: add ClipShot to a Focus, switch on Pause copying, and new screenshots are not copied while that Focus is on. A pause or resume you set yourself meanwhile is kept.
  • clipshot, a command line tool inside the app. clipshot latest prints the path of the screenshot you just took, for scripts and coding agents; copy, pause, resume and clean go through the running app. The Homebrew cask puts it on your PATH.
  • Settings for the macOS screenshot folder and preview, a warning with a one-click fix when macOS is set to send screenshots to the clipboard or an app instead of a file, and Restore previous settings.
  • English, Slovak, Czech, German, Spanish and French. A downloaded copy updates itself; a copy installed with Homebrew updates with brew upgrade --cask clipshot.

Signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled. Requires macOS 26.
